fightSong.title: Clam Chowdah
fightSong.lyrics: From the harbor to the Garden floor / We chow down and we want more / Thick as fog, hot as steam / Chowderheads, we live the dream!

stadium.name: The Kettle
stadium.tradition: The Ladle Drop — a 20-foot ladle pours (fake) chowder over a giant bread bowl at kickoff. If it 'spills' toward opponent's end zone, good omen.

fanCulture.description: They've seen 6 championships and act like they've seen 60. After interceptions they chant 'SOUP'S ON.' They will correct your pronunciation of 'chowder.'
fanCulture.tailgate: Actual chowder, served in sourdough, in 20-degree weather. No one complains.

rivalries.name: The Chowder Run
rivalries.narrative: New York stole our accent and our attitude. We kept the chowder.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: First down Boston! That's wicked good!

cityFlavor: We invented America, dunked tea in the harbor, and never let anyone forget it. History with a side of chowder.
